KaTeX 0.18.4 stylesheet and fonts (MIT, see /licenses/katex.LICENSE), from the
npm package `katex@0.18.4`. This version matches the KaTeX that Hugo 0.169's
`transform.ToMath` renders with. Only the .woff2 fonts are included; the .woff
and .ttf fallbacks were removed from katex.min.css. Upgrade this together with Hugo.
